replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Godot. I didn’t like how Astra was building the cities so I actually made it build me a custom plugin that makes it like city skylines/sim city. I can build all the roads, move the lanes, zone out the residential, commercial etc, and it builds it. You can then go in and replace stuff but I was trying to go procedural where I can. The idea of my game is more of an open ended life simulator, 10 years of a characters life, the city will change based on your actions.

replies.author: shayeryan
replies.body: Damn, that sounds fun, I would play that! I originally got inspired to do something like this cus of big ambitions. I thought it would be fun to have big ambitions with a crime element.

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: To be honest I was working on this mostly to test out some ideas for how to handle simulations and chunk loading. I built 2 other zelda style games, nes style and a more isometric 2.5d snes Zelda style game but for the 3rd one I wanted to really expand on the world and go fully 3d and in order to do that I needed to solve several problems: one was traversal. I had a grappling hook in my game so I wanted to carry that over to 3d BUT I wanted to make it so you could grapple nearly anything (including enemies for dragons dogma/shadow of the colossus) style fights. The end boss was going to be essentially you but based on how you played the game. So solving an ai being able to navigate an environment, freely, on the fly, with no pathing, is the biggest challenge. I actually got the idea to try and mix robotics research with nvidias motion tech because that’s not really an area being explored in video games. So I wanted to solve that and I wanted a simulation of all the enemies and npcs so I was testing that with an rpg game I’m building in a voxel world. I’m hoping to combine the asset streaming, pathfinder tech and background simulation tech into a 3rd person rpg style game with matrix style fluid movement and combat set in a high fantasy world. Swinging around enemies, back flipping off shields. The real benefit is video games geometry is a known factor unlike the real world where the robotic sensors have noise and other things to deal with. It’s super ambitious but I think we’re almost there capability wise and maybe it’ll be useful to some other people

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: The life simulator is basically going to be a lot of mini games and the rub is everything you do will eat time. So if you want to be a cab driver, that’s gonna require a license, which will take some time off your year. Want to join the police? 6 months in the academy. You’ll need to basically balance how you want to live your life. Being a police officer you might clean up the neighborhoods and property values increase, nice businesses pop up, you maybe drive a cab and get roped into maybe being a get away driver. You get locked up, lose a year but you make a friend in jail, now you’re a crook. Maybe run for mayor, maybe lose your house and live in your car. All should be viable options lol. There’s also permadeath and you get basically a eulogy or a happier ending at the end of the game with people honoring you a dinner etc

replies.author: shayeryan
replies.body: So do you have a life time? so you when your life is up? what happens? what if you have offspring? maybe they inherit your skills, pass them on, generations, etc..

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: You play a year, the city advances a year and so on. So you’ll see the changes reflected and kind of get a report on your standing. The idea is to basically experiment and experience things but you’ll not be able to play every life in every playthrough so you’ll play a new character and see what their life is like and how you want to play them. The game will present you with moral choices as well. You can be a cop but more importantly you can be a crooked cop or by the book. It will affect how far you go, whether you get killed on the job, promoted. Maybe you run for mayor but you took bribes as part of the police and it ruins your campaign. That level of stuff
